entries.title: Leviticus 3:1
segments: ¶And if his oblation [be] a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer [it] of the herd; whether [it be] a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:2
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:3
segments: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards, {fat: or, suet}

entries.title: Leviticus 3:4
segments: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away. {caul...: or, midriff over the liver, and over the kidneys}

words.text: that [is] on them, which [is] by the flanks
. {caul...: or, midriff over the liver, and over the kidneys}

entries.title: Leviticus 3:5
segments: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which [is] upon the wood that [is] on the fire: [it is] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

words.text: : [it is] an offering made by fire

entries.title: Leviticus 3:6
segments: ¶And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD [be] of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:7
segments: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:8
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:9
segments: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, [and] the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:10
segments: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

words.text: that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks

entries.title: Leviticus 3:11
segments: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: [it is] the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.

words.text: of the offering made by fire

entries.title: Leviticus 3:12
segments: And if his offering [be] a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:13
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:14
segments: And he shall offer thereof his offering, [even] an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:15
segments: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

words.text: that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks

entries.title: Leviticus 3:16
segments: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: [it is] the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat [is] the LORD'S.

words.text: of the offering made by fire

entries.title: Leviticus 3:17
segments: [It shall be] a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
